name: Baked cornflake hot-honey chicken schnitzel

source.author: Instagram — caliai.app (Hebrew caption)
source.notes: Oven-baked (no-fry) cornflake-crusted chicken strips with a honey-sriracha-soy glaze. The post PROVIDED whole-dish macros: 870 kcal | 80 g protein | 105 g carb | 13 g fat — verified as consistent with the ingredients (protein + fat match closely; carbs run a touch higher, likely more cornflakes/honey). Stored as the post's numbers. It's a big single dish (~350 g); easily split into 2 servings (~435 kcal each).

serving_desc: 1 whole dish (~350 g cooked) as the post lists it — a big meal; split into 2 for ~435 kcal each
steps: Season chicken; dredge flour → egg → crushed cornflakes; bake 200 C 18–20 min flipping halfway; brush with the simmered honey-sriracha-soy glaze.

him.verdict: Impressively lean for a schnitzel — it's BAKED, not fried, so the whole dish has only 13 g fat while packing 80 g protein (~9.2 g protein per 100 kcal). The catch is carbs: ~105 g from the cornflake + flour crust and the honey glaze (~34 g of that is honey sugar). Split into 2 it's ~435 kcal / 40 g protein / 52 g carb each — a solid protein-forward meal. The honey glaze is the main sugar lever; the crust is refined carbs.
flags: 80 g protein, only 13 g fat (baked not fried)
suggested_mods: Split the dish into 2 servings for logging — 870 kcal is a big single meal
Cut the honey to 1 tbsp (halves the added sugar) — the sriracha still carries it
Use low-sodium soy; serve over salad/greens for fiber the crust lacks

her_preconception.verdict: Lean high-protein chicken with choline and selenium, baked and fully cooked — no safety flags. The honey and sriracha are fine for her. It's carb/sugar-heavy and not a big micronutrient source, so it's a good protein main rather than a nutrient star; pair with veg for folate/vitamin C.

safety_advisories.note: Cook the chicken fully through (74 C / no pink) — standard for schnitzel.

suggested_mods: Serve with a big leafy/veg side for folate + vitamin C
Use low-sodium soy to ease the salt

cooking_guide: Cut the chicken into even strips and toss with the crushed garlic, smoked paprika, salt and pepper.

Set up 3 bowls: flour / beaten egg / crushed cornflakes. Dredge each strip flour → egg → cornflakes, pressing the cornflakes on for a thick, even crust. (Crush the cornflakes coarse, not to powder — that's what makes the crunch.)
Lay the strips on a lined tray; for all-around crisp without frying, set them on a wire rack over the tray and lightly spray/brush with oil.
Bake at 200 C (400 F) for 18–20 min, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through (74 C, no pink).
Meanwhile simmer the honey, sriracha, soy sauce and garlic powder 1–2 min on medium until glossy.
Brush the glaze on AFTER baking (or toss just before serving) — glazing before baking would burn the sugar and soften the crust.
Tip: cornflakes give a lighter, crunchier crust than breadcrumbs; add the sauce at the last moment to keep it crisp.
